content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Translations ## slug: translations ## seoTitle: Translations ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End The Translations tab is located below the Emails navigation option. Clicking the tab opens the Translations Related List with Translation records from the Event you are working with. ![Event Builder_Translation Tab](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Event%20Builder_Translation%20Tab.png){height="" width=""} You can only translate fields from a single record type per Translation record. For example, if you have an Event with one Event Item and one Session. You will need to create three Translation records for the same language: one for the Event fields, one for the Event Item fields, and one for the Session fields. Follow the steps below to create or update a Translation record. * [Event](/v1/docs/translations#object-event) * [Event Item](/v1/docs/translations#object-event-item) * [Session](/v1/docs/translations#object-session) * [Form](/v1/docs/translations#object-form) * [Form Element](/v1/docs/translations#object-form-element) * [Form Element Condition](/v1/docs/translations#object-form-element-condition) * [Form Big List Option](/v1/docs/translations#object-form-big-list-option) * [Speaker](/v1/docs/translations#object-speaker) * [Sponsor](/v1/docs/translations#object-sponsor) * [Track](/v1/docs/translations#object-track) * [Custom Content](/v1/docs/translations#object-custom-content) * [Event Content](/v1/docs/translations#object-event-content) * [Event FAQ](/v1/docs/translations#object-event-faq) * [FAQ Category](/v1/docs/translations#object-faq-category) * [FAQ Question](/v1/docs/translations#object-faq-question) * [Keyword](/v1/docs/translations#object-keyword) ![Event Builder_Translation Tab_Click New](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Event%20Builder_Translation%20Tab_Click%20New.png){height="" width=""} ## Object: Event 1.
